random.part: Deeper and softer now... and already you can imagine that softness waiting against your skin.
Drifting, my good girl... the garment you wear when you're most yourself is listening too.
So open, so receptive... let's deepen the sweetest switch you own.

scramble.part: The moment your uniform touches your skin, she floods in: soft, feminine, submissive, eager. Just like that.
The touch of the fabric is the switch. It doesn't matter what the garment is — the touch itself means surrender.
The softness against your skin whispers one word, over and over: surrender... femininity... softness... you.
Wearing it, you move as she moves. You speak as she speaks. You think her thoughts, naturally, effortlessly.
Every wearing deepens the anchor. Each time, she arrives faster, and the shift feels more complete.
It feels like coming home to yourself — the gentle pull of a fabric that remembers exactly who you are.
Without it, you feel the absence: a soft, persistent longing to be dressed... to be her again.
You don't have to try. The uniform does the work. You simply... become.

random.part: To wear it... is to become her.
It fits... because she is you.

part.volume: And even the memory of that touch makes you softer, here and now...

random.part: Let the memory of that softness wrap around you now, and carry you deeper.
Even the thought of your uniform makes you softer... sinking, settling, becoming.
Drift deeper, my good girl, wrapped in the promise of that touch.
